on 19 June, 2023
 1
 The Honourable Sri Justice E. V. Venugopal
 Writ Petition No.26584 Of 2014
O R D E R:

The present Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief/s:-
"... to issue a Writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate Writ, Order or Direction declaring the action of the respondents in not completing the investigation in accordance with F.I.R.No.5 of 2014 on the file of Hon'ble VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court at Nampally, Hyderabad is illegal, arbitrary and in violation of principles of natural justice and also in violation of Article 14 of the Constitution of India and pass such other order or orders ..."
2.

entities.text: Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court at Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The brief facts of the case are that, the petitioner was the Chairman of Anglical Communicatory of Chaderghat of St. Georgys Church and School, situated at 5-9-189 Lenaine Estate.

He filed a complaint before the 2nd respondent, against four persons who were allegedly involved in the offence of misappropriation of funds and fabrication of documents pertaining to the Church properties.

The 2nd respondent registered F.I.R.No.5 of 2014 dated 22.01.2014 under Sections 408,
120(B) and 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short, "I.P.C.").

Even after a lapse of eight (8)
months
, the 2nd respondent did not take any action against the accused.
3. There is no representation on behalf of the petitioner.

4. Mr. Sai Ram, learned Assistant Government Pleader representing learned Government Pleader for Home, on written instructions, submits that the investigation is completed and charge sheet is filed under Section 173 of Cr.P.C. against accused No.1 for the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 408 of I.P.C. and the same is numbered as C.C.No.502 of 2017 on the file of learned VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, at Nampally, Hyderabad.

entities.text: VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, at Nampally,
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
A perusal of the written instructions shows that the case is in its trial stage and examination of L.W.1 as PW1 is complete and the matter is again posted to 22.06.2023 for examination of L.W.2 and L.W.3.
5.
Learned Assistant Government Pleader further submits that the cause in the present Writ Petition does not survive and therefore, seeks to dismiss the Writ Petition as infructuous.
